stats.notes: No Common Data Set found: berea.edu does not post one. Counts are Berea's own Fall 2025 first-year figures from the Fact Book 2025-26 (first-year applications, accepted and enrolled): 4,633 completed applications, 726 accepted (15.7%), 396 enrolled. 'International' is the college's F-1 International group (not a US citizen, permanent resident or refugee): 2,943 completed applications, 38 accepted, 29 enrolled (the other applicants are 1,146 in-territory and 544 out-of-territory). Berea sorts domestic applicants by its 361-county Appalachian 'territory', not by state, so the in-state and out-of-state fields are left empty. The deadlines page lists Early Action I and II and Regular (no early decision); no waitlist figures were found. The SAT and ACT submit rates (6% = 24 students, 35% = 142 students) are IPEDS fall 2024, matching the score ranges below; the Fall 2025 class profile says 215 (58.6%) of 367 domestic first-years applied test optional. The average GPA of 3.63 is the college's 'recalculated' high-school GPA (college-preparatory classes only, from the Fall 2025 class profile); it is unavailable for 34 students, including 29 international students. Undergraduate enrollment (1,500) and F-1 international degree-seeking students (129) are Fall 2025 degree-seeking headcounts from the Fact Book.

cost.notes: Published sticker prices for 2025-26 from the Fact Book 'Cost of Attendance' table: tuition $54,700, required fees $780 (four fee lines of $108, $176, $34 and $462; tuition and fees are billed as one charge from 2025-26), room and board $9,142 (two lines of $5,000 and $4,142), books and supplies $750, personal and transportation lines of $1,800 and $1,350 (other costs shown = their sum), total cost of attendance $68,522. NO STUDENT PAYS TUITION: the Fact Book says 'No student pays tuition'; the college pays it from endowment, gifts and grants brought by students (the college's 'no-tuition promise'). The college's pages say all admitted international students receive financial aid and scholarships covering 100% of tuition, housing, food and fees (see aid notes). The 2026-27 sticker price was not found.
